source_policy: Completed UTC 1H/4H OHLCV aggregated from checksum-validated 1m futures archives; retain native higher-timeframe archives and every discrepancy; not resampled indicators
execution: Next eligible 1m open at/after modeled publication availability; stops remain active; ambiguous intrabar stop/target is stop-first; gap stops fill adversely; full taker exits
trend_exit: Completed 1h close <= EMA50 for long, >= EMA50 for short; next eligible modeled open
partition_boundary: Start flat; force remaining positions flat at last minute close; no trades cross partitions; preserve original indicator seeds
sizing: Independent equal-capital sleeves; entry notional plus fee capped to positive current sleeve cash equity; fractional research quantity; no leveraged liquidation model
funding: Actual timestamp/rate/associated mark price; positive funding debits longs and credits shorts; absent coverage blocks replay
historical_filters: Dated current price-filter snapshot applied across history; historical filter changes not reconstructed
uncertainty: Deterministic 3-calendar-month moving-block bootstrap, 2000 replications; small partition samples disclosed
status: Preregistered local research specification; no parameters selected from results
